pointIdentifiability.interpretation: Retrospective fixed-model point/common-clock diagnostic; not official coordinates or a uniquely identified institutional formula

training.unchangedRecipe: USNO solar coordinates at date UTC00; horizon -50 arcminutes; sunrise -7min, Dhuhr +5min, Maghrib +7min; nearest UTC minute; original missing-window seasonal model for all transfer events
training.primaryObjective: Minimum uniform extra half-width (seconds) beyond the original nearest-minute cells, over one latitude and longitude per city. All observations participate; no event/day rejection or extra free parameters.

numericSearch.nonzeroMinimizerRefinement: Golden-section search (80 iterations) inside every local minimum grid bracket, including boundaries; deterministic tie resolution at 1e-7 seconds by closest latitude to proxy then lower latitude.
numericSearch.exactFeasibleTieBreak: If grid points admit strict exact cells, select the feasible grid latitude closest to proxy, then the lower latitude; choose the midpoint of the feasible longitude interval. This is deterministic, not a claim about the true point.
numericSearch.infeasibleLongitudeChoice: Clamp the midpoint of maximum lower and minimum upper longitude constraints to the predeclared longitude box.
numericSearch.globalCertificate: A conservative analytic derivative bound for horizon times supplies grid minimum minus K*step/2 as a lower bound on the global minimum slack. The selected point supplies an upper bound. Closed-cell infimum is reported separately from strict upper-bound exact feasibility.
numericSearch.uncertainty: Report all feasible grid latitude ranges and longitude interval at selected latitude; if inconsistent, report minimum-slack bounds and active contradictory constraints. These are conditional numerical feasible regions, not statistical confidence intervals or actual production coordinates.

identifiabilityLimits: Longitude has an exact -240 seconds/degree effect on raw fixed-epoch training events, confounded with any unknown common clock offset
Latitude may trade against unknown horizon/refraction or other formula errors; those parameters are fixed here, not estimated
Both years and all outcomes were previously exposed in the overall project;2027 is retrospective transfer, never a new holdout
No fitted point will be added to public profiles, an app, or represented as an official source coordinate
